items.item_text: Current California Clinical Laboratory Scientist License (CLS) or Clinical Microbiology Scientist (CMS).
Previous technical and practical experience in Bacteriology, Mycology, Mycobacteriology, and/or Parasitology.

Join us as a Clinical Laboratory Scientist in the Microbiology lab at the Brentwood Annex. You will assist with various technical procedures in the Bacteriology, Mycobacteriology, Mycology, and Parasitology sections. Primary responsibilities include performing urine cultures, blood cultures, gram stains, fungal stains, and BD Max PCR, as well as troubleshooting laboratory instruments and reagent preparation.
Strong educational background and advanced training in Microbiology.
Must pass the Ishihara Color Vision exam, i.e. visual acuity including color differentiation.

Demonstrated working knowledge of current instrumentation, including BD Bactec FX, bioMerieux Vitek 2 and MS systems, centrifuges, water baths, analytical balance, fume hood, biological safety cabinet, and incubator.
